source_finding: The guard compares a configured bind address with local interface addresses. The address is read from hbase.regionserver.info.bindAddress or hbase.master.info.bindAddress, default 0.0.0.0. The InfoServer bind and HTTP requests in TestInfoServers#testInfoServersRedirect happen after this guard. Injecting IOException at or before InetAddress.getByName exits before the selected predicate, while later server/network exceptions cannot change the prior configuration value.
decision: Do not schedule exception fuzz from the current selector. This is a weak static coordination candidate, not a no-test classification: the MiniCluster test reaches startup, but it offers no demonstrated relevant pretarget exception door. Revisit only if an existing passing cluster test supplies a dynamic I/O-influenced bind address and named target-retained fault evidence.
scope: Source-only weak-candidate record; no JVM/fault/full and no canonical-table classification.
